1  SRI VINAYAKA.V.S, HCGP FOR R2)
 -2-  CRL.P No. 11285 of 2022

THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.439 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN CR.NO.73/2021 OF RAYALPAD P.S., KOLAR DISTRICT FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 363, 376(2)(n)(3), 506 OF IPC AND SEC.6 OF POCSO ACT ON THE FILE OF THE ADDL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE,
FTC-I (POCSO), KOLAR IN SPL.C.(P)NO.61/2021.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.
None present on behalf of the petitioner.
Even in the previous occasion also there is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.
2. Learned counsel for the second respondent is present.
3. The present petition is filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., and the offence alleged against the petitioner is under Sections 363, 376(2)(n)(3), 506 of IPC along with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
The petition came to be filed on 14.11.2022 and there is no progress.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed for non prosecution.
